title: Repeated inbound firewall blocks from one source
why: One blocked packet is a misdirected application; forty from the same address inside ten minutes is a scan. Counted per source address, so a chatty LAN device cannot hide a scanner inside its own noise: the noisiest legitimate source on this host peaked at 28 blocks per ten minutes, which is why the threshold sits above it.
false_positives: a LAN device with a retry loop or a broken service-discovery daemon
your own vulnerability scanner run from another host
NAT collapsing several machines behind one source address
